But the threats of remaining are greater than or equal to the threats of secession|[[Givin/Legends|Givinian]] Senator [[Daggibus Scoritoles]]|<ref name="NEW54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|regional/1352_1.html|Yag'Dhul Secedes}}</ref>}}
The '''Secession of Yag'Dhul''' was one of the defining events of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], occurring on the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] and its domains unilaterally declared their withdrawal from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], after which it became a reliable stronghold of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], supporting the fight against Republic forces in the region.

==History==
===Prelude===
The final [[Standard month/Legends|months]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had been a chaotic dance of shifting alliances and desperate overtures. When the war finally broke out, it almost came as a relief. The secession of the planets [[Secession of Ando|Ando]] and [[Secession of Sy Myrth|Sy Myrth]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] three months before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] had marked a tipping point. The two worlds and their sector fiefdoms had brought the total number of Separatist planets to more than six thousand. The [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] had struggled to contain the displaced citizens, leading to civil unrest throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Weeks later, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] announced that his sector had closed its borders and would no longer participate in future discussions. With the cry of «[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]]», the Republic lost the support of one of its founding [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="NEC" />

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] responded to Corellia's withdrawal with an offer to [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] to negotiate a peaceful solution to their [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|differences]]. Dooku did not appear, and the Republic shook under a rapid-fire string of prominent secessions.<ref name="NEC" />

The [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]], [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar]], [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra]], and [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis]] sectors all joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist movement]], making the entire [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|rimward]] leg of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] inaccessible to Republic shipping. The [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] followed suit, bringing with it the planets [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and [[Oorn Tchis]] as well as the Mirgoshir hyperspace crossroads. The [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] gave the Separatists more than two hundred farming planets when it seceded.<ref name="NEC" />

===Secession===
{{Quote|The discriminant of the quadratic never lies|Senator Daggibus Scoritoles justifies the calculations about the secession|<ref name="NEW54" />}}
As the splintering of the Republic became increasingly common, the [[Body Calculus]] on the planet [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], together with the collective domain and range of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] people, decided to leave the larger Republic. Senator [[Daggibus Scoritoles]] transmitted Articles of Secession via the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] in the morning, making the separation official. In the process, he expressed regret that the decision had been made but emphasized that «the threats of remaining were greater than or equal to the threats of secession». The statement was also simulcast across the broadcast towers of Yag'Dhul's largest civic shelters. The transmission was accompanied by numerous charts and graphs explaining the action. According to the broadcast, the Body Calculus's most revered mathematicians had developed functional models of the Republic's political situation. By advancing the model along its time axis, the resulting projections indicated a bleak future for both the Republic and Yag'Dhul specifically.<ref name="NEW54" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|Sure, the numbers are dismal if they factored in their [Givin] own cowardice. I'd invoke the Corellian proverbs about odds, but now with even the Corellians hiding their heads, I'm hesitant to do that|Senator [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] condemns the statement about the secession of Yag'Dhul|<ref name="NEW54" />}}
At a conference following the Senate session in which the Givin proclaimed their independence, the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] voiced its dismay at the secession of Yag'Dhul. However, the emotional reaction was mixed: while Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] urged respect for the beliefs of the Givin theocracy, Senator [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] accused the Givin of cowardice.<ref name="NEW54" />

Yag'Dhul had been a very prosperous world that possessed valuable technological, [[Science/Legends|scientific]], and [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] resources. Thus, the Republic suffered a major blow with the formal secession of this planet and its domains,<ref name="NEW54" /> while the Separatists gained an important ally in the form of talented Givin [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogators]], who helped develop newer and faster [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] for the Confederacy.<ref name="IC73">{{InsiderCite|73|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:01:15 Edition}}</ref><ref name="IC74">{{InsiderCite|74|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition}}</ref> The Secession of Yag'Dhul also provided the Separatists with access to, and control of, the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="CEI194">{{CSWECite|I|343|Givin}}</ref>
